subtitleNullable: A (Mostly) Complete Set of Results from Marathons Across the US and Canada
descriptionNullable:
This dataset contains a (mostly) complete set of results from marathons across the United States and Canada in 2024.

The dataset is restricted to races with more than 200 finishers. Some races are therefore excluded, but they account for a small share of the total number of finishers.

The dataset is also restricted to races that are USATF-certified. Most of the races are road marathons, although some trail races are included. But these are "road-like" trail marathons, where times are similar to the road and can be used for Boston qualifying purposes.

This dataset is similar to the [one I created with results from 2023](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/runningwithrock/2023-marathon-results). The two datasets can be combined, but the race names differ in some cases. You'll have to clean up the race names to get them to group correctly.

I initially collected these results to prepare the dataset for the [2026 Boston Marathon Cutoff Time Tracker](https://runningwithrock.com/boston-marathon-cutoff-time-tracker/). I also used it to update my [percentile-based age grade calculator](https://runningwithrock.com/age-grade-calculators/), to calculate [the average marathon times for each age group](https://runningwithrock.com/average-marathon-time/), to identify [a list of the largest races in the United States](https://runningwithrock.com/2024-largest-marathons-us/), and to support various other analyses.

If time permits, I plan to update this dataset to include additional information about each race - including the location and the weather on race day.
